customManagers.description: Talos installer pin in talos-image.env. Source of truth for manual node upgrades; the SUC plan below covers the automated path and the two must not drift. A bump here does NOT require regenerating SCHEMATIC_ID: the schematic ID is a content hash of the extension list and is independent of the Talos version -- the same ID serves v1.12.0 through v1.13.9. Only editing schematic.yaml changes it. The talos group is still never auto-merged, for the real reasons: the upgrade reboots nodes, and the Image Factory builds per (schematic, version) pair, so a brand-new release may have no image for these extensions yet. The Talos image workflow checks both.
Talos version in SUC upgrade plans (spec.version drives the installer tag via SYSTEM_UPGRADE_PLAN_LATEST_VERSION)

talosctl image inside the SUC upgrade plans. This is the TOOL that performs the upgrade, not the target version, and it had no manager at all -- which is why it sat two and three patch releases behind spec.version while both were supposedly kept in step. Grouped with siderolabs/talos so the tool and the target move together.

Factory installer tag in the machine configs. Decides which Talos a rebuilt node installs, so leaving it behind talos-image.env means a rebuild lands on the old version and needs an immediate upgrade. The SCHEMATIC_ID in the same string is NOT tracked and must still be regenerated by hand whenever the schematic changes.

Factory installer tag inside the SUC upgrade plans. This is the image the automated upgrade actually installs, so it is the one that decides whether the Longhorn extensions survive a reboot. Tracked alongside spec.version and the talosctl tool image in the same files -- all three must move together, and the grouped talos PR is where that is checked.

packageRules.description: Group all Talos ecosystem updates into one PR
Label major updates — CI workflow uses this to skip Trivy auto-merge
Label minor/patch updates — CI Trivy gate evaluates auto-merge eligibility
Disable digest updates for Talos images
Route all patch updates through Trivy gate (no Renovate-side automerge)
